text: By the way, there is a small nuance with the time you receive the second practice. If you signed up before 18:00, then you will receive the second practice at the nearest midnight. If you signed up after 18:00, then you will receive the second practice not at the nearest midnight, but at the following midnight. That is, you will have a reserve of time in case you do not manage to complete the practice on the day you signed up for the intensive.
